neet_che_u15_t09_1.working: Resonance makes every C-C bond in benzene equal at 139 pm. This lies between a C-C single bond (154 pm) and a C=C double bond (134 pm).

neet_che_u15_t09_2.working: The cyclopentadienyl anion is cyclic, planar and fully conjugated with 6 pi electrons, so it obeys 4n+2 with n=1. Cyclooctatetraene has 8 pi electrons and is non-planar. Cyclopentadiene contains an sp3 carbon. Hexatriene is acyclic.

neet_che_u15_t09_3.working: Naphthalene has 5 C=C bonds, giving 10 pi electrons. Setting 4n+2 = 10 gives n = 2.

neet_che_u15_t09_4.working: Benzene is III (neutral aromatic, all bonds 139 pm). COT is I (8 pi electrons, tub-shaped). Tropylium is IV (aromatic cation, 6 pi electrons). Cyclopentadiene is II (has an sp3 carbon).

neet_che_u15_t09_5.working: A is true. B is false because benzene gives only one 1,2-disubstituted isomer. C is true. D is false because COT has 8 pi electrons (4n) and is non-planar, so it is not aromatic. E is true.
